services.name: Kids Fishing
services.desc: Let us introduce your kids to fishing by taking them on one of my family friendly inshore fishing adventures. Making memories with your children on a family fishing charter is what it's all about. I know how to make fishing fun for kids and keep them interested and entertained. Action packed is usually key and keeping them reeling something in constantly will keep them smiling and entertained. However, some children will get on the boat and spend more time playing in the baitwell with the baitfish than fishing and that’s completely fine! When you're a kid how many times are you allowed to stick your hand in the aquarium at home and pick up the fish? It’s all about exploring and learning!

includes: All tackle, bait and fishing licenses provided
USCG required safety equipment aboard all vessels
blurb: Guests can enjoy various guided boat tours including fishing trips, wildlife observation, shark tooth hunting, clamming, and scenic rides along the Cape Fear River and Intracoastal Waterway. Trips offer opportunities to see local wildlife such as alligators, dolphins, and birds, and explore areas like Masonboro Island Reserve. Fishing trips provide all tackle, bait, and fishing licenses, with a focus on family-friendly experiences and catch and release encouraged.
extraNote: $100 deposit required to secure your trip · Catch and release strongly encouraged; guests may keep legally allowed catch · We do not clean fish but can refer you to a cleaner · Gratuity is appreciated if you enjoyed your time aboard · 220 Annie Drive, Carolina Beach, NC 28428
